_about: Path groups that must change together (tools/check/check.py 'parity'). Globs are fnmatch ('*' crosses '/'). A group fires when a 'trigger' side (default: any side) changed and another side didn't; skip with 'Parity-skip: <group>: <reason>'. 'fail' groups fail a range / merge, 'warn' groups only remind. App sides only: the frozen PoC (poc/) is in no group. Every glob must match a tracked file (static check 'parity-globs'): a dead glob silently turns a group off. Not grouped (one platform only, so nothing to pair): the doctor's report (no app has it) and the CSV export writer (Mac SukraraCore/Export only; Android has no CSV export) — add the group back with the second platform.

groups.name: graph
groups.why: One graph everywhere: the Android renderer (:core:graph) and the Mac renderer (SukraraGraph) lay out and draw the same card

groups.name: graph-fixtures
groups.why: Graph decisions (badges, slots, labels, what every surface lays out) are pinned by contracts/graph fixtures: add or update a case

groups.name: alerts
groups.why: One alert engine: Android :core:alerts and Mac SukraraAlerts implement the same rules (contracts/alerts/SPEC.md)

groups.name: alert-scenarios
groups.why: Every alert-rule change adds or updates a timeline scenario (contracts/alerts/scenarios); never change a scenario's expectations without the owner's OK

groups.name: alert-spec
groups.why: The alert rules and settings JSON (contracts/alerts/SPEC.md, copy.json) are implemented by Android and Mac in the same change

groups.name: protocol-v2
groups.why: PROTOCOL-v2.md (Nostr + BLE sharing) is implemented by Android and Mac in the same change

groups.name: identity
groups.why: PROTOCOL-identity.md (names, generated pictures) is implemented by Android and Mac in the same change

groups.name: protocol-v2-impl
groups.why: Wire code changed on one platform only: check PROTOCOL-v2.md and the other platform

groups.name: ogs-spec
groups.why: The app wire specs (PROTOCOL-v2.md, treatments/SPEC.md) are published as the Open Glucose Sharing draft: keep its vectors in step

groups.name: treatments
groups.why: The treatment form and JSON (contracts/treatments) are shared by Android and Mac

groups.name: strings
groups.why: Every English string has its Spain-Spanish twin in the same module (StringsParityTest)

groups.name: export-fixtures
groups.why: The CSV export cases (contracts/export) are what the writer must produce (Mac only: Android has no CSV export; add its side with the writer)

groups.name: settings
groups.why: Settings never diverge: a schema change (contracts/settings/settings.json) regenerates both SettingsSpec files (python3 tools/settings/gen.py)

groups.name: durations
groups.why: Duration formatting cases (contracts/settings/durations.json) are what both Durations formatters produce

features._about: App behaviour code; a change needs docs/FEATURES.md in the same range, or 'Features-skip: <reason>'.
